description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ramos.
When Ramos enters the battlefield, Railway Brawler and Emiel trigger.
Resolve the Railway Brawler trigger, putting four +1/+1 counters on Ramos.
Resolve the Emiel trigger, causing you to pay {G/W} to put a +1/+1 counter on Ramos.
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
